control_chart.caption: Stable process — points vary randomly inside the control limits.
Mean shift — the average jumps midway through the run.
Gradual drift — a slow upward trend walks toward the upper limit.
Special-cause spikes — isolated points break the control limits.

High variation — a wider spread stresses the range portion.
